Reliable, accessible, interoperable, and fit for purpose marine geospatial information is essential for translating international legal and policy commitments into practical action. During the reporting period, the Joint Working Group considered how its work could better support the United Nation Convention on the Law of the Sea and the BBNJ Agreement. These discussions underscored the need for closer collaboration among the relevant communities in support of ocean governance, safety of navigation, biodiversity conservation, and sustainable development. Finally, successful implementation of the work plan will require broad, sustained, and geographically balanced participation. We therefore invite member states that are not yet represented to nominate experts and join the joint working group. We also welcome the continued engagement of relevant organizations and encourage existing members to play an active role in implementing the work plan.
